```{python}
import re
import pandas as pd
```
```{python}
# Stopwords (from Day 18)
stopwords = ["the", "to", "and", "of", "a", "her", "i", "in", "was", "it",
             "she", "he", "be", "that", "you", "not", "had", "as", "his", "for",
             "with", "is", "have", "but", "at", "so", "all", "my", "been", "him",
             "on", "by", "could", "would", "very", "no", "what", "which", "they",
             "were", "there", "me", "an", "must", "this", "said", "from", "or",
             "will", "any", "much", "than", "such", "their", "them", "if", "do",
             "did", "one", "when", "your", "more", "are", "we", "who", "up",
             "out", "down", "into", "s", "t"]
```
```{python}
with open("../../homework/hw5/hw5_raw.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    fin_lines = f.readlines()


clean_text = re.sub(r'\[.*?\]', '', fin_lines)

fin_text = "".join(fin_lines)
```
```{python}
verses = re.split(r'\s*\[.*?\]\s*', fin_text)
verses = verses[1:]
```
```{python}
rows = []
verses_num = 0

for verse in verses:
    verses_num += 1
    lines = re.split(r"[\n]+", verse.lower())   # split on \W AND on _
    lines = [l for l in lines if l != ""]
    for l in lines:
        rows.append({"line": l, "verses": verses_num})

fin_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
```
```{python}
# 4. Save it for next time
fin_df.to_csv("hw5_deweese_abagail.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
```

```{python}
queen_by_chapter = {}

for w, ch in zip(fin_df["line"], fin_df["verses"]):
    if w == "queen":
        if ch in queen_by_chapter:
            queen_by_chapter[ch] += 1
        else:
            queen_by_chapter[ch] = 1

print(queen_by_chapter)
```

#type/token ratio
```{python}
tokens = len(fin_df)
types = fin_df["line"].nunique()     # number of unique words

print(tokens, types, types / tokens)
```
